common_event_topology.qualification: The audited Sapphire model has no merger/satellite event system.

continuous_local_rhs.qualification: SAGE16 and SHARK run in-process; Sapphire is delegated to its pinned native runtime.

local_conservation.qualification: SAGE16 and SHARK use structural ledgers; Sapphire uses native rates with explicit open-system boundaries.

local_state_jacobian_and_modes.qualification: Each result belongs to its recorded operating point and state coordinates.

parameter_response.qualification: One normalization API is available, but parameters are not presumed to be physically interchangeable.

same_halo_history_population.qualification: Sapphire smooth-central forcing has not been matched to SAGE16/SHARK branch topology and population weights.

supply_to_sfr_response.qualification: SAGE16/SHARK perturb cooling; Sapphire perturbs halo accretion upstream of its CGM.

halo_atmosphere.comparison: qualified; these are not synonymous reservoirs

star_forming_gas.comparison: qualified because phase and aperture definitions remain model-owned

tracked_metals.comparison: shared total ledgers; reservoir-level mapping is qualified
tracked_metals.sapphire: stellar, ISM, and CGM metal reservoirs
tracked_metals.shark: six metal reservoirs plus formed-metal tracker

shared_observables.star_formation_rate: direct local quantity in all three
shared_observables.stellar_mass: direct local quantity in all three
shared_observables.stellar_mass_function: requires a weighted common population and is not evaluated for Sapphire here
shared_observables.stellar_metallicity: available in all three model ecosystems; only Sapphire is exercised in this controlled native artifact
